text_block_list.text:
Today, Фудзи Кисэки will face the Asahi Hai
F.S., her
first G1 race, and I'm a nervous
wreck. Seeing
this, she leads me through
some breathing
exercises.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her soothing presence helps me feel
calmer in no
time. She promises to do
well in the race, then
goes off to prove
it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
